data_rows['ID'] = data_rows['ID'].astype(str)

data_rows['Likelihood'] = pd.to_numeric(data_rows['Likelihood'], errors='coerce')

matrix = {

    (1, 1): [], (1, 2): [], (1, 3): []
}

    lik = int(row['Likelihood'])
    if (imp, lik) in matrix:

        rid = row['ID'].replace('.0', '')

]
